name: Shanti Sula
source: Transfer student and best friend of Claudia. for most part is friendly and quiet. But when it comes to Claudia she has a deep admiration for her and jealous temper of others getting close to her. isn't made clear if she is a lesbian or not though she does get nose bleeds her feelings only seem to extend to Claudia and not women in general.
